主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the fourth quarter of 2017 and full year ended December 31, 2017. The full text of the press release is included as Exhibit 99.1. The information in this report and the attached exhibit is not deemed "filed" under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, nor is it incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, unless expressly stated. The report also details the resignation of Richard Bergmark as Chief Financial Officer, effective after the 2018 annual shareholders’ meeting, and his retirement from the Supervisory Board by the end of the meeting. Christopher Hill, currently Chief Accounting Officer, will replace Bergmark as CFO. Hill has held various roles at the company since 2006, including Corporate Controller and Investor Relations. Prior to joining the company, he worked at Halliburton and Ernst & Young. He holds a BBA in Accounting from Texas A&M University, received in December 1992. He is on schedule to receive an Executive MBA from the University of Texas at Austin in 2019.
